Easiest 2025 schedules:

1. SF - OVER (12 wins > 10.5)
2. NE - OVER (14 wins > 8.5)
3. NO - OVER (6 wins > 4.5)
4. ATL - UNDER (8 wins < 8.5)
5. BUF - UNDER (12 wins < 12.5)

Hardest 2025 schedules:

32. NYG - UNDER (5 wins < 5.5)
31. CLE - OVER (5 wins > 4.5)
30. DET - UNDER (9 wins < 10.5)
29. PHI - UNDER (11 wins < 11.5)
28. MIN - UNDER (9 wins < 9.5)
27. KC - UNDER (6 wins < 11.5)

how many wins for the Cowboys this year?

notes:

last year the Cowboys played the #3 easiest schedule

they won 7 total games

in their 8 games vs teams with a winning record...

they won 1-of-8

in their 7 games vs teams who made the playoffs...

they won 1-of-7

they went 3-1 in games decided by 3 points or less

this year, they play 10 teams projected to have a winning record
